title: ISPR: 21 Militants Killed in North Waziristan Over 72-Hour Period
detail: Pakistan's Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) announced that security forces killed 21 Fitna al-Khawarij (TTP) militants in a series of intelligence-based operations in North Waziristan over a 72-hour period ending June 13, 2026, as Pakistan's domestic counterterrorism tempo continued alongside the resumed cross-border strike campaign.

sources.name: Pakistan Today — 21 terrorists killed in North Waziristan operations over 72 hours: ISPR

media.caption: ISPR reported 21 militants killed in North Waziristan IBOs over 72 hours.

title: Unexploded Ordnance Kills 1 Child, Injures 6 Others in Sangin, Helmand
detail: Two separate unexploded-ordnance (UXO) explosions struck Sangin district, Helmand province on June 13, 2026. The first, in the Chawk Majid area, injured four children; the second, around 10:00 a.m. in the Ab Zarandi area, killed one child and injured two others. The incidents add to Afghanistan's ongoing landmine/ERW crisis — UN Mine Action recorded at least 175 people killed or injured by landmines and explosive remnants of war nationwide between January and May 2026, roughly 75% of them children, with only $3.6 million of a needed $14.5 million in clearance funding secured.
